title: Read a small page of results
summary: REST API Development: Read a small page of results. Write the request using the next link.
introduction: Pagination divides a large collection into smaller pieces. This example returns a next link.
learningObjectives: Read a small page of results with REST API Development
Write the request using the next link

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.
Read a small page of results

blocks.title: Read a small page of results
blocks.code:
GET /books?limit=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"items":[{"id":1}],"next":"/books?after=1&limit=1"}

blocks.text: limit=1 asks for one result. The next field gives a URL that continues after that item.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: The client gets one item and a link for the next page.

blocks.text: Write the request using the next link.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a stable ordering so items do not jump between pages.
